provenance.notes: Short mirror of G-GAP-DCA-L-01: market reflected around the base price, signals and side flipped. DCA levels 100.98 / 101.98 / 102.98 (ATR 1), basket stop 104.98. Candle 282 opens at 102.4 (= its low, green: the first path point is the open), through two levels: both safety orders sell at the open, 102.4 x 0.9998 = 102.37952, q = 0.612245 + 0.918367. avg 101.874358, basket target avg - 1 ATR = 100.874358, reached in candle 285 (red, low 100.8743 - shaped so the leg ends just past the target, as the long ends at 99.125 past 99.124884); exit at the target x 1.0002. The flat candles after 282 stay below the third level (high 102.95).
